Here's a description of the provided plot, following the guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between epoch and Word Error Rate (WER) for different model types. The x-axis is labeled “epoch”, has a linear scale, ranges from 1 to 6, and has tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “WER”, has a linear scale, ranges from 30 to 70, and has tick labels at intervals of 10. A solid line with circular markers, colored black, represents “tiny AdaLoRA_int4”, starting at approximately 62 at epoch 1 and decreasing to approximately 52 at epoch 6. A dashed line with circular markers, colored gray, represents “tiny AdaLoRA_int8”, beginning at approximately 60 at epoch 1 and decreasing to approximately 51 at epoch 6. A dash-dot line with square markers, colored light gray, represents “tiny int4”, starting at approximately 58 at epoch 1 and decreasing to approximately 50 at epoch 6. A dotted line with asterisk markers, colored dark gray, represents “tiny int8”, beginning at approximately 32 at epoch 1 and increasing to approximately 41 at epoch 6.
